final:
isqrt(n: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= 0 and out * out <= n and n // (out + 1) < out + 1
  ex isqrt(0) == 0
  ex isqrt(1) == 1
  ex isqrt(15) == 3
  ex isqrt(16) == 4
  var lo = 0
  var hi = n
  if hi > 3037000499
    hi = 3037000499
  while lo < hi
    let mid = (lo + hi + 1) // 2
    if mid * mid <= n
      lo = mid
    else
      hi = mid - 1
  lo
